52.246-11 Higher Level Contract Quality Requirement (Manufacturers)
FAR CLAUSE 52.246-11 APPLIES. A QUALITY MANAGEMENT PROGRAM MEETING THE REQUIREMENTS OF ISO 9001:2008; A PROGRAM COMPARABLE TO ISO 9001:2008 (EXAMPLE SAE AS 9100), THE FOLLOWING TAILED VERSION OF ISO 9001:2008; OR A PROGRAM COMPARABLE TO THE TAILED VERSION OF ISO 9001:2008 (EXAMPLE SAE AS 9003) IS REQUIRED. IN THE TAILED VERSION OF THE ISO 9001:2008, ANY REFERENCES WHICH CITE THE ENTIRE INTERNATIONAL STANDARD ARE INTERPRETED AS EXCLUSIONS TO THIS DOCUMENT.
